title: From using AI to [building with it].
sub: A staircase; a ball climbs it and the top landing turns blue.

title: [Hours back], every week.

title: Built on [your work], not examples.
sub: A workbench with a document, a sheet and an envelope; each is picked up in order and joined by a line.

title: Everyone is a [builder].
sub: Five lamps over a bench; one comes on, then the rest.

title: An agent that [owns the job].
sub: An unattended desk; sheets move from the in-tray to the out-tray one at a time.

title: The five levels, [one on the next].
sub: Five books stack on a table, one on the next.

title: Before by hand, [after it runs].
sub: A machine with a tangled cord; the cord pulls straight, plugs in and the light comes on.

title: Live, [together].
sub: Five people join a live session, one at a time.

title: Built on [your company's work].
sub: A folder with a company logo; three labelled sheets rise out of it. Repeats for three companies.

title: Skills, agents, workflows, [one system].
sub: Three keys go onto one key ring.

title: Real names, [real backgrounds].
sub: Three empty tiles become three named experts.

title: One conversation could [open the door].
sub: Two speech bubbles, then a door opens.

title: Get there, with the people [who've been there].
sub: Brand photo of the stairs wipes up; the tagline appears line by line.

title: [Own your future.]
sub: The Leland lockup draws on and settles; the line appears word by word.

title: A license is not [adoption].
sub: An office building on white; one window is lit, then the lights come on floor by floor.

title: Support in [layers].
sub: A column built in four courses, each named as it lands.

sub: Three calendar pages; the days fill from October and stop at the blocked-out holidays.

title: Leaders first, then [every team].
sub: A pebble drops into a pond; three ripples spread to the shore.

title: One person, [more output].
sub: One person beside three piles of pages that keep growing.

title: Level one opens the [door].
sub: Five doors; the first opens, the others follow part way.

title: Your best people have [day jobs].
sub: A week planner fills with meetings; one block is handed to an expert.

title: Progress you can [show the board].
sub: A tape measure is pulled out from a baseline mark to a follow-up mark.

title: One system, not [two silos].
sub: A room with a dividing wall; the wall lifts and two tables slide into one.

title: Experts who have [been there].
sub: A hill with a flag and an expert at the top; the trail lights down to you.
